25d66595.text: Eonar also blessed Alexstrasza's younger sister, the lithe green dragon Ysera, with a portion of nature's influence. Ysera fell into an eternal trance, bound to the waking Dream of Creation. Known as the Dreamer, she would watch over the growing wilds of the world from her verdant realm, the Emerald Dream.
25d66595.title: Charge of the Dragonflights

2677e79a.text:
Lady Cassandra Valor, Loving mother and wife

Not much is known about Cassandra other than her love for her family. She nurtured brave children and a powerful husband, leading some to muse that the family's greatness was all her doing. A flattery she would always decline with grace.

If she is remembered for nothing else, let it be known that everything she did was for her family.
2677e79a.title: Memories of Valor

3728af3c.text:
Ira Valor, Forest Stalker

When Ira's father grew ill, she took it upon herself to gather food and supplies from the nearby forests. While resources were not in short supply, you were as likely to find food as you were to become it.

Over the years, she adapted to the forests, preferring to spend her time within the dark woods rather than in Raven Hill. Travelers who got lost in the trees would tell stories of a shadow seemingly opening the way for them back to the road. There was no confirmations of who it was, but rumors spread quickly.

It's said that Ira is still in the woods offering a guiding hand to those who fall prey to the beasts within.
3728af3c.title: Memories of Valor

5c3b2fb2.text: Satisfied that the small world had been ordered and that their work was done, the Titans prepared to leave Azeroth. However, before they departed, they charged the greatest species of the world with the task of watching over Kalimdor, lest any force should threaten its perfect tranquility. In that age, there were many dragonflights.
5c3b2fb2.title: Charge of the Dragonflights

626bcabc.text:
Refined Ore - There is a dwarf in Thelsamar, a smith that I trained with for some time, named Bailor Stonehand. He makes a very special alloy that I think would be perfect for your weapon. I expected a shipment of the alloy to arrive while I was in Ironforge, but I have yet to hear word from him.

Find him and check on the shipment. And if he's no longer in Loch Modan, I would at least know what's happened to my old teacher.
626bcabc.title: Jordan's Weapon Notes

6afc0413.text: Khaz'goroth, the Titan shaper and forger of the world, bestowed some of his vast power upon the mighty black wyrm, Neltharion. The great-hearted Neltharion, known afterwards as the Earth-Warder, was given dominion over the earth and the deep places of the world. He embodied the strength of the world and served as Alexstrasza's greatest supporter.
6afc0413.title: Charge of the Dragonflights

755fd17f.text: Yet there were five flights that held dominion over their brethren. It was these five flights that the Titans chose to shepherd the budding world. The greatest members of the Pantheon imbued a portion of their power upon each of the flights' leaders. These majestic dragons (as listed below) became known as the Great Aspects, or the Dragon Aspects.
755fd17f.title: Charge of the Dragonflights

78a9bec7.text:
SAINT,
Before I go any further, let me thank you again for everything you've done for my wife and I. You saved her life, and for that, I owe you far more than I could possibly repay in a hundred lives. She is everything to me. If she would have died... well, I don't know what I would have done.

Here is the list of things you'll need to recover if I am going to forge a holy weapon for you. I put them in order of what I thought was easiest to hardest--I hope that makes it simpler for you.
78a9bec7.title: Jordan's Weapon Notes

97cf423d.text:
Among them, the smithing hammer my father gave me. I doubted it in my youth, but he always told me the hammer was enchanted, and it's the last reminder I had of him before he was killed by the Scourge.

Bring me my hammer, SAINT, so I may use it as a focus for my passion. If it is indeed enchanted, then it will only aid us both.

I left it in the stables in the main courtyard of the keep. Unless the creatures there have taken up smithing themselves, then I expect it to still be lying there.
97cf423d.title: Jordan's Weapon Notes

9dec14a6.text:
Some good whitestone oak - Before it was taken over, the mines below Moonbrook in Westfall had an abundance of the lumber; they used it in the construction of some of their more important lattices and tools because of its resilience to heat and pressure.

It was brought down there after being shipped from overseas somewhere. It's a rare wood that is plenty strong enough to be used in the crafting of your weapon. If any of it's left in the mines, then the goblin woodcarvers would have it.
9dec14a6.title: Jordan's Weapon Notes

b0897304.text:
Merrick Valor, Watcher of Darkshire

Merrick was the youngest son of the Valor family. As he witnessed the corruption coming to his homeland, he chose to join The Watch in a desperate bid to protect his loved ones.

While he was the most inexperienced member of his family, he quickly made a name for himself amongst the ranks of The Watchers. He had a knack for archery, and soon became one of the most staunch defenders of Darkshire.

His personal mission was to keep the roads safe, wary of the ever more hostile creatures coming to the forests.
b0897304.title: Memories of Valor

b38214e6.text:
Lord Grant Valor, Sire of the Valor Family

Lord Grant, may he rest in peace, was the pinnacle of Alliance exceptionalism. A natural leader, his guiding hand helped lead the denizens of Raven Hill to prosperity. When darkness began to creep into the woods, he was the first to rally our people.

There was no more foul a foe than the undead to Lord Grant. He personally patrolled the cemeteries of Duskwood to keep the shambling hordes in check. The day he took a grievous blow from the monsters, everyone in town shared his pain.

With his family's care, he returned to his duties, but there was a lingering malady that seemed to follow him for the rest of his days.
b38214e6.title: Memories of Valor

cbaed4dc.text: Eonar, the Titan patron of all life, gave a portion of her power to the red leviathan, Alexstrasza. Ever after, Alexstrasza would be known as the Life-Binder, and she would work to safeguard all living creatures within the world. Due to her supreme wisdom and limitless compassion for all living things, Alexstrasza was crowned the Dragonqueen and given dominion over her kind.
cbaed4dc.title: Charge of the Dragonflights

d4c61cda.text:
A Kor Gem - From the tales I've been told, the gems are used by some spell casters to hold energy for their magics, making them even deadlier. A night elf I once helped, Thundris Windweaver, can tell you more since you will be speaking on my behalf. I believe one of the gem's stored energies can be used in your weapon's creation.

When last we spoke, Thundris was in Auberdine a town deep within Darkshore, the corrupted forest that dots the coast underneath the shadow of the night elf homeland.
d4c61cda.title: Jordan's Weapon Notes

d557c053.text:
Memories of Valor
A Recount of the Valor Family and Their Service to Raven Hill

There was no greater family in all of the Eastern Kingdoms than the Valor family. Their deeds to the people they swore to protect were nothing short of miracles, and their loss is a loss for all of Raven Hill.

I write this account to set the record straight, detailing the marvels that were Grant, Ira, Silvia, and Merrick. May these writings be a small consolation for how sorry I am for their absence.
d557c053.title: Memories of Valor

d9560c37.text: Thus empowered, the Five Aspects were charged with the world's defense in the Titans' absence. With the dragons prepared to safeguard their creation, the Titans left Azeroth behind forever. Unfortunately it was only a matter of time before Sargeras learned of the newborn world's existence....
d9560c37.title: Charge of the Dragonflights

e92d0b56.text:
Smithing Hammer - Before the coming of the Plague and Arthas' betrayal, I lived in a town called Pyrewood, deep within the beautiful forest of Silverpine. The forest isn't nearly as beautiful as it once was, and the keep where I learned the secret of steel has long since become corrupt and foul, overrun with creatures of unimaginable evil.

When my wife and I made our escape from what is now called Shadowfang Keep, we left some of our most precious possessions.
e92d0b56.title: Jordan's Weapon Notes

ec82091a.text:
Silvia Valor, Raven Hill Guard

Silvia Valor had already been a local hero by the time she was offered to join the Guard. If there was one thing she could not stand to suffer more than anything, it was opportunists who took advantage of those who were struggling.

Bandits, con artists, rabble-rousers, it didn't matter. Silvia put each to the sword for trying to sow chaos in her beloved home. It was only natural she would be put in a position of real authority to act out her vision of justice.

It's said that, until she drew her last breath, she would never abandon the farmsteads and homes of Duskwood. And perhaps not even then.
ec82091a.title: Memories of Valor

f0791e73.text: Norgannon, the Titan lore keeper and master-magician, granted the blue dragon, Malygos, a portion of his vast power. From then on, Malygos would be known as the Spell-Weaver, the guardian of magic and hidden arcanum.
f0791e73.title: Charge of the Dragonflights

f8380a2e.text: Aman'Thul, the Highfather of the Pantheon, bestowed a portion of his cosmic power upon the massive bronze dragon, Nozdormu. The Highfather empowered Nozdormu to guard time itself and police the ever-spinning pathways of fate and destiny. The stoic, honorable Nozdormu became known as the Timeless One.
f8380a2e.title: Charge of the Dragonflights

11096|ddec75b2.name: Randal Worth
11096|ddec75b2.text: I already know a lot about style. Now it's just a matter of mastering the techniques for working with leather. Good thing Simon's a real sport about helping me learn them.

1244|245cbd71.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
1244|245cbd71.text:
The roots and ferns speak well of you, small one. Although I have many names, I answer to few. But you may call me Rethiel.

And you must harken... for these lands weep from festered wounds, and I would charge you to heal them.

1289|ed056522.name: Gunther Weller
1289|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1289|fe52f4ea.name: Gunther Weller
1289|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1292|aebd25b1.name: Maris Granger
1292|aebd25b1.text: Do I look like I have the time or energy to coddle every tourist that wanders through my door? Tell me what you need, and make it quick.

1300|e17121fb.name: Lawrence Schneider
1300|e17121fb.text: Hmm... the things you need to learn are a little above my head. Have a talk with Sellandus over at Larson's Clothiers just up the path to the right. He taught me everything I know!

1314|0624ab70.name: Duncan Cullen
1314|0624ab70.text: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

1314|23d8b931.name: Duncan Cullen
1314|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

1321|877c4b1d.name: Alyssa Griffith
1321|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

1346|29243a62.name: Georgio Bolero
1346|29243a62.text: You'll need more training before I can share my knowledge with you, I'm afraid.

1347|0624ab70.name: Alexandra Bolero
1347|0624ab70.text: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

1347|23d8b931.name: Alexandra Bolero
1347|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

1416|c14f3f06.name: Grimand Elmore
1416|c14f3f06.text:
If you've come looking for the finest craftsmanship on this or any other continent in the world, then you've come to the right place!

Grimand Elmore, at your service!

14722|00e95851.name: Clavicus Knavingham
14722|00e95851.text:
Friend - Stormwind needs your assistance and your generosity!

Our once large stockpile of textiles has run critically low.  Stormwind is now engaged in a multi-pronged effort to rebuild those stocks for the manufacture of textiles and bandages!  Your donation of cloth would help Stormwind immensely, as well as earn the respect of the citizenry!

1480|4d61ac25.name: Caitlin Grassman
1480|4d61ac25.text: Alchemy can help so many people! It's my life's passion.

2094|28b1f157.name: James Halloran
2094|28b1f157.text: Greetings, $c. I'm in a bit of a pinch right now, running very low on hides.

2104|fe329646.name: Captain Stoutfist
2104|fe329646.text: Menethil Harbor enjoys a bit of peace these days, thanks to the mountaineers.  But we must be ever watchful of new threats from our enemies.

2456|105cd232.name: Newton Burnside
2456|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2457|105cd232.name: John Burnside
2457|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2457|2237a3b1.name: John Burnside
2457|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

258568|ed056522.name: Antonio Bolero
258568|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

268|f1060a41.name: Sirra Von'Indi
268|f1060a41.text: Greetings, $c! I have but one goal: the cataloging and recording of all knowledge related to the history of Duskwood and Darkshire. Perhaps you could help me in my endeavor?

270637|3e0b4d08.name: Howin Kindfeather
270637|3e0b4d08.text: So many Wildhammer lives lost... whole families erased...

295|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Farley
295|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

3136|b873f90f.name: Clarise Gnarltree
3136|b873f90f.text: Now I'm the one who feels rough around the edges, I honestly don't think there's anything left I can teach you. But you know who can? Bengus Deepforge in Ironforge, now there's a dwarf that knows his steel. Go look him up in The Great Forge of Ironforge, see if he's up to having a new trainee under him.

3518|fe52f4ea.name: Thomas Miller
3518|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

352|4946c28b.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|4946c28b.text: Where is it ye would like to go lad? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

4981|ed056522.name: Ben Trias
4981|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

5491|837f02f9.name: Arthur the Faithful
5491|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

5511|cbb91364.name: Therum Deepforge
5511|cbb91364.text: I said ye had the blood of a blacksmith in ye, and I was right. Go to Ironforge, to The Great Forge, and find yerself a Dwarven smith by the name of Bengus Deepforge. My teacher, and one of the greatest smiths I've ever known.

6740|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Allison
6740|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

68|9e9bec9c.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|9e9bec9c.text: What do you need directions to?

1243-complete.name: Watcher Backus
1243-complete.text:
Oh, Trias sent you, huh? That's a little different.

Feel free to fight whatever monstrosities come at you from the darkness. I'm sure you'll be able to handle it pretty easily if you're the type to be hanging around with the likes of him.

So, what does my friend need of me on such a gloomy day as this?
1243-complete.title: The Missing Diplomat

1243-progress.name: Watcher Backus
1243-progress.text:
Not too safe to be traveling about in the woods, $N. Be careful, and if you see anything suspicious or dangerous, contact the Watchers immediately. Don't try and take anything on yourself. We're not responsible for anything terrible that might happen to you.

But we both know you're gonna ignore me and fight whatever comes out of the darkness anyway, don't we? Haha, yeah, you adventurer types... all the same.
1243-progress.title: The Missing Diplomat

1244-accept.name: Watcher Backus
1244-accept.text:
Defias activity? Well, there's always some activity; even if they keep to themselves we consider them a threat.

But now that I think about it, there was a recent sighting that seemed odd. It must have been a couple weeks ago, but some of their agents had gathered around Addle's Stead. From the report, I'd guessed something big went down.

Why don't you check there first and bring me back anything you find?

The farmstead is south of the road from Westfall just as you enter Duskwood.
1244-accept.title: The Missing Diplomat

1244-complete.name: Watcher Backus
1244-complete.text:
You're back safe and sound. Couldn't ask for much more than that, could you?

Now, let's see what we have here. This looks pretty official as far as any Defias documents I've seen. But it could be a dupe just to throw you off track of whatever it is you're looking for.
1244-complete.title: The Missing Diplomat

1244-progress.name: Watcher Backus
1244-progress.text: Be careful out there, $N. I know Trias was the one to send you here, but that doesn't mean there isn't anything lurking out in the woods that couldn't cause you some trouble... especially with you investigating the Defias.
1244-progress.title: The Missing Diplomat

1245-accept.name: Watcher Backus
1245-accept.text:
Whoa, this looks way too complex to be something to just lead you astray. I shouldn't even be looking at this stuff. Take it to Trias--he'll be able to make sense of it. And DON'T let anyone get in your way. This is bigger than me. It might even be bigger than him, but we'll see.

And do me a favor, $N, don't tell anyone I helped you. If my superiors found out I knew about any of this and didn't share it with them they'd probably hang me.
1245-accept.title: The Missing Diplomat

1245-complete.name: Elling Trias
1245-complete.text:
Yeah... this is an interesting read. Jorgen and DeLavey were smart to bring me in on this.

Seems the Defias have been trying pretty hard to complete this plan of theirs. Hmm... what's this? "Fist"? That's a familiar name.
1245-complete.title: The Missing Diplomat

1245-progress.name: Elling Trias
1245-progress.text: I see you're back, and in one piece. We both know you're not here for cheese, so let's cut out the pleasantries. Was Backus any help, or have you even left for Duskwood yet?
1245-progress.title: The Missing Diplomat

1246-accept.name: Elling Trias
1246-accept.text:
Yeah, now that I think about it... Dashel... Dashel something... What was his name? FIST! Dashel Stonefist. They call him Fist in some circles--probably on account that he likes to get in brawls.

You can find him in Old Town usually--right smack dab in the center of it. Go talk to him. If you have to, use a sword or something heavy and blunt to persuade him to open up some. And don't hesitate. If he's in this as deep as these papers suggest, then he's not going to give you any information willingly.
1246-accept.title: The Missing Diplomat

1246-complete.name: Dashel Stonefist
1246-complete.text:
What?!

You come into me alley and ask questions about me personal business? Business which you obviously have nothing to do with.
1246-complete.title: The Missing Diplomat

1247-accept.name: Dashel Stonefist
1247-accept.text:
So yeah... um... I might know something 'bout that meeting at Addle's Stead. Happened a few weeks back I think. I really didn't have any part in it. Me part was done when plan A failed... damn adventurers.

The guy we got on the inside for plan B came out of Menethil; guy called Slim. That's all I know regarding their backup plan.
1247-accept.title: The Missing Diplomat

1247-complete.name: Elling Trias
1247-complete.text:
Good to see you're still alive, $N. So, it went well with Dashel then, huh?

I've been reading up more on this plan of theirs, and although it doesn't state the name of the diplomat they were after, it does talk about this plan B they enacted after failing on their first attempt to capture him.

This Slim that Dashel mentioned doesn't have any other name written here, but if you say he's in Menethil, then that's a start.
1247-complete.title: The Missing Diplomat

1248-accept.name: Elling Trias
1248-accept.text:
A contact of mine retired in the Wetlands at the harbor city of Menethil. He should be willing to help on your word alone if you tell him you're working for me. His name is Mikhail. He mentioned becoming a bartender before leaving Stormwind a few years ago.

Speak to him, find this Slim, and find out if there's anything else to know about this kidnapped diplomat. We need to find out where they've taken him, or at least who he is. The docket doesn't mention anything about their plans after he's captured.
1248-accept.title: The Missing Diplomat

134-complete.name: Abercrombie
134-complete.text:
Thank the Nec-...well, thank YOU, $N!  You have more than earned your reward.

Aha!  Happy!  Happy nights ahead!!
134-complete.title: Ogre Thieves

134-progress.name: Abercrombie
134-progress.text: Do you have my crate?  If so, then please...give it to me quickly!
134-progress.title: Ogre Thieves

1447-accept.name: Dashel Stonefist
1447-accept.text:
Yeah, you're obviously not the smartest $c to come into Stormwind, but you're about to be one of the dumbest to never leave.

Have you met me friends?
1447-accept.title: The Missing Diplomat

1447-complete.name: Dashel Stonefist
1447-complete.text: So, you came to me for a reason. What is it you need?
1447-complete.title: The Missing Diplomat

160-accept.name: Abercrombie
160-accept.text:
Take this note to Ello Ebonlocke, the Mayor of Darkshire.

He and I are old friends...and when he reads it and discovers what you did for me...I'm sure he'll be just as happy as I am!  Hahahaha!
160-accept.title: Note to the Mayor

160-complete.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
160-complete.text:
<Ello looks at the letter...>

What language is this?  It looks ancient...I can't read it.
160-complete.title: Note to the Mayor

160-progress.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
160-progress.text:
Abercrombie...?  I don't know a person of that name.  You say you have a letter for me from this Abercrombie fellow?

Well let's have it then...
160-progress.title: Note to the Mayor

181-complete.name: Viktori Prism'Antras
181-complete.text: At last!  The stargazing device is complete!  Thank you, $N.  Now I can continue my research. . .
181-complete.title: Look to the Stars

181-progress.name: Viktori Prism'Antras
181-progress.text: Were you able to convince Zzarc'Vul to lend us his monocle for our experiment?
181-progress.title: Look to the Stars

225-accept.name: Unknown
225-accept.text:
The weathered grave marker reads simply:

MORGAN LADIMORE

<Upon further examination, you notice that dirt over the grave has been recently disturbed, and that a good amount of the dirt seems to have been displaced...>
225-accept.title: The Weathered Grave

225-complete.name: Sirra Von'Indi
225-complete.text:
Morgan Ladimore?

Ahh, yes, of course. His was a long and sorrowful tale. I knew him, well, before he left for the war, but that was the last time I saw him. A noble and good man, he was, but he suffered a bad end.

Here, I should have something here that can tell the tale better than my own recollections...
225-complete.title: The Weathered Grave

227-accept.name: Sirra Von'Indi
227-accept.text:
<He searches through the shelves and comes up with a leatherbound book.>

If you would like to know more, you might ask Althea, she's been the one to handle the... trouble... with him of late.
227-accept.title: Morgan Ladimore

227-complete.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
227-complete.text:
Morgan Ladimore? Never heard of...

Oh, you mean Mor'Ladim! I guess you haven't heard the story?

Well, I'll give you the short version. A wandering undead calling itself Mor'Ladim has been wandering Duskwood. From what we've gathered, it appears to be the undead body of Morgan Ladimore, of whom you apparently know. He's been causing us all sorts of problems, attacking Watchmen on patrol and killing people.

<She sizes you up.>

You seem to be capable enough, maybe you could lay him to rest.
227-complete.title: Morgan Ladimore

228-accept.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
228-accept.text:
From what my scouts tell me, Mor'Ladim wanders throughout Duskwood, following a strange and meandering path through the cemetery. We buried him out past the house on the hill, you know where that is?

There isn't anything I can do to help you, but I wish you good luck.
228-accept.title: Mor'Ladim

251-accept.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
251-accept.text: Take the note you gave me to Sirra Von'Indi.  He's very learned in languages and ancient arts - if anyone here can translate this message, it's he.
251-accept.title: Translate Abercrombie's Note

251-progress.name: Sirra Von'Indi
251-progress.text: A note from Abercrombie the hermit, eh?  I don't know him, though if he lives out at the graveyard then I do know his brains have rotted out!
251-progress.title: Translate Abercrombie's Note

252-accept.name: Sirra Von'Indi
252-accept.text:
Oh my!  If what is written on this note is true, then Abercrombie's done something...unspeakable.

You better bring the translated note back to Ello.

And do so quickly, for I fear a doom already lumbers toward our town...
252-accept.title: Translation to Ello

252-complete.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
252-complete.text:
<Ello reads the letter...and his face goes white.  He then looks at you...>

Although the aid you gave Abercrombie may have been motivated from kindness, your actions have doomed our town.

<Ello becomes lost in his thoughts...>
252-complete.title: Translation to Ello

252-progress.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
252-progress.text: Ah, is the note translated?  Please, let me see it...
252-progress.title: Translation to Ello

253-accept.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
253-accept.text:
The Embalmer is a name told in one of our children's stories.  He was a kindly alchemist, driven mad by the death of his wife, Eliza.  To restore her, he used dark magic to place his own heart within the bosom of his dead spouse.

This revived Eliza...but it cursed her with a hunger for $r flesh, forcing the Embalmer to keep her buried.

His heart is his power.  Find his wife's grave, retrieve his heart, and bring it to me while it still beats.  Do this and his power will be broken.
253-accept.title: Bride of the Embalmer

275-accept.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
275-accept.text:
I do not know why, but a festering grows within the Wetlands. Fen Creepers have risen. They are diseased, fevered blisters on the land, and for the fever to break they must be dispatched and allowed to settle back into the marshes.

The Fen Creepers shamble amidst the waterways of the Wetlands.
275-accept.title: Blisters on the Land

275-complete.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
275-complete.text: This land is soothed by your efforts, and for this I will grant you a boon.
275-complete.title: Blisters on the Land

277-complete.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
277-complete.text: ... thank you. I will smash these flints and cast them into the sea, so that they may never again be used to burn living wood.
277-complete.title: Fire Taboo

277-progress.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
277-progress.text: Do you have the Gnolls' tools for fire?
277-progress.title: Fire Taboo

290-complete.name: Unknown
290-complete.text: The key is rusted but it fits the lock neatly.
290-complete.title: Lifting the Curse

292-accept.name: Unknown
292-accept.text:
Opening the chest reveals a blackened orb, pulsing with an eerie light.  It is the treasure of which Fitzsimmons spoke: a Cursed Eye of Paleth.

Take the Cursed Eye of Paleth to the dwarven priest Glorin Steelbrow, in Menethil Harbor. Ask him how to remove the Eye's curse.
292-accept.title: The Eye of Paleth

292-complete.name: Glorin Steelbrow
292-complete.text:
An Eye of Paleth? Amazing! Hmm...there's something wrong with this one. You found it on one of those shipwrecks?  Well that explains it! But...I didn't know they had such an Eye on the Third Fleet...

It's no wonder Fitzsimmons was so spooked. A Cursed Eye of Paleth is no cause for mirth.
292-complete.title: The Eye of Paleth

292-progress.name: Glorin Steelbrow
292-progress.text: That drunk Fitzsimmons sent you to me? Well, you can tell him I don't have any extra ale. He's going to have to panhandle someone else!
292-progress.title: The Eye of Paleth

2928-accept.name: Shoni the Shilent
2928-accept.text:
It's terrible, $N. We are not going to have enough parts to get our fleet of gyrodrillmatic excavationators to Dun Morogh.

What we need are spare parts, $N. What better place to get the spare parts for our vehicles than Gnomeregan? I hear that bots and mechs roam around that place like cattle on an open range.

What I need you to do is go to Gnomeregan and tear apart those robots. Bring me back their robot guts. Two dozen should be sufficient.
2928-accept.title: Gyrodrillmatic Excavationators

293-accept.name: Glorin Steelbrow
293-accept.text:
I can't lift the curse from the Eye of Paleth. The Eyes were crafted by $R Priests, so you'll have to go to Stormwind to find someone who can help you. Speak with Archbishop Benedictus. He is head of the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind.  He can help.

I hope, for your sake.
293-accept.title: Cleansing the Eye

293-complete.name: Archbishop Benedictus
293-complete.text:
An Eye of Paleth. But this one has seen much sorrow...it must have been witness to a terrible, terrible tragedy.

Let me cleanse it, for the Eyes were created to shine bright, and their powers can be quite dangerous if tainted like this one.
293-complete.title: Cleansing the Eye

293-progress.name: Archbishop Benedictus
293-progress.text: What is that orb you have? It looks...soiled.
293-progress.title: Cleansing the Eye

322-complete.name: Grimand Elmore
322-complete.text:
That is quite a tale you have.  And lightforge iron!  Not for years have I worked with such a metal.  It will be an honor to craft with it again.  And you must return to me later with the story of your battle against the Necromancer.

But we get ahead of ourselves.  First, your weapon against Morbent Fel...
322-complete.title: Blessed Arm

322-progress.name: Grimand Elmore
322-progress.text: How might I ply my craft for you, $c?
322-progress.title: Blessed Arm

325-accept.name: Grimand Elmore
325-accept.text: Here is the weapon against the fiend of which you spoke.  You're all ready, $N.  Best of luck to you, and I look forward to your tale of glory!
325-accept.title: Armed and Ready

325-complete.name: Sven Yorgen
325-complete.text:
Ah, this will be proof against the fiend Morbent Fel!  Well done!

You are ready.  Morbent Fel will fall.
325-complete.title: Armed and Ready

325-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
325-progress.text: Hello, $N.  You haven't been gone that long, but I see a fire in your eyes I did not see before.
325-progress.title: Armed and Ready

377-accept.name: Councilman Millstipe
377-accept.text:
As if the neglect for the residents of Duskwood was not bad enough, now the House of Nobles spits in the eye of the Darkshire Council with their decision to imprison Dextren Ward in Stormwind rather than behead the villain as per Lord Ebonlocke's sentence.

Ward was caught selling bodies from the cemetery to Morbent Fel, a crime punishable by death.  Yet Stormwind claims Ward as their prisoner.

Assassinate Ward in The Stormwind Stockade - bring me his hand - and I shall reward you.
377-accept.title: Crime and Punishment

388-accept.name: Nikova Raskol
388-accept.text:
Bitterness flows through my veins like a cold river.  My grandson, Mac, was such a good boy.  A mere 14 years old.  When the army was sent off to the front, Mac took up arms to defend the city.  He was a guard in The Stockade, where the Defias gang is locked up.  Mac reprimanded some of the prisoners for tearing their wool blankets to make scarves, a symbol of their gang.  For that Mac was stabbed in the back.

I want revenge.  Bring me 10 of their precious Wool Bandanas.  They are the color of blood.
388-accept.title: The Color of Blood

401-accept.name: Sirra Von'Indi
401-accept.text: I'm almost finished translating that note.  If you come back in a few moments I should be done.
401-accept.title: Wait for Sirra to Finish

401-complete.name: Sirra Von'Indi
401-complete.text:
There we are.  It's translated...

<The air grows heavy, as if a thick, black curtain is drawn over the land...>
401-complete.title: Wait for Sirra to Finish

464-complete.name: Captain Stoutfist
464-complete.text:
Well fought, $N. The Dragonmaws are not the same threat they were when they had dragons, but they're still fierce opponents.

The Dragonmaws are led by Nek'rosh, son of Nekros, who was the former head of the Dragonmaws years ago. Nekros used powerful magic to tame the Red Dragons, but when that magic failed him...the dragons were not happy.

Nekros was killed, and his son has vowed revenge against the dragons who slew his father.
464-complete.title: War Banners

464-progress.name: Captain Stoutfist
464-progress.text: Have you attacked the Dragonmaw encampment?
464-progress.title: War Banners

465-accept.name: Captain Stoutfist
465-accept.text:
The Dragonmaw are closer to enacting their attack plans than we thought.

Nek'rosh has built catapults and aims to lay siege to Menethil! And with the fighting in Dun Algaz, we're effectively blocked from reinforcements!

You need to take out those catapults. They're in the Dragonmaw encampment.

Here, take this tinder. Fight your way to the catapults and light them with the tinder.

And after you've done that, find and kill Nek'rosh. We need to cut this Dragonmaw beast down...at its neck.
465-accept.title: Nek'rosh's Gambit

465-complete.name: Unknown
465-complete.text:
You place some of the tinder on the catapult then strike a spark onto it.

Flame erupts and quickly spreads!
465-complete.title: Nek'rosh's Gambit

465-progress.name: Unknown
465-progress.text: The first catapult is before you. Will you set it aflame?
465-progress.title: Nek'rosh's Gambit

474-accept.name: Unknown
474-accept.text: Now that the catapults have been burned, find and kill Chieftain Nek'rosh.
474-accept.title: Defeat Nek'rosh

474-complete.name: Captain Stoutfist
474-complete.text:
Stoutly done, $N.  You have dealt a telling blow to the Dragonmaw orc clan.  They may never recover.  And the destruction of those catapults has made Menethil Harbor safe.

You are a $R of merit, and the kingdom of Ironforge rewards those who serve it well.
474-complete.title: Defeat Nek'rosh

55-accept.name: Sven Yorgen
55-accept.text:
Morbent Fel hides in his lair, the house perched atop the hill to the east overlooking the Raven Hill cemetery.  His time in this land is drawing to an end...

Use Morbent's Bane against him.  It will render his protective magics powerless.

Slay him.  Slay him, and save us from his wickedness.  Be the instrument of my revenge, and a hero of Duskwood!
55-accept.title: Morbent Fel

55-complete.name: Sven Yorgen
55-complete.text:
Morbent Fel has been defeated.  The dark riders are still at large, but a small piece of that which I had hoped beyond hope has come to pass.

You have done the impossible, and your deeds will forever live in the legends of Duskwood.

Go, $N.  And perhaps, one day, fate may bring you back to me...
55-complete.title: Morbent Fel

7791-progress.name: Clavicus Knavingham
7791-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Stormwind for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7791-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

98072-progress.name: James Halloran
98072-progress.text: Ah, $N! Do you have those scales?
98072-progress.title: Crocs of the Sky

98223-progress.name: Captain Stoutfist
98223-progress.text: I can practically hear the cries of the Dragonmaw from here! They deserve every bit of it and more.
98223-progress.title: Old Habits

98282-progress.name: Caitlin Grassman
98282-progress.text: Have you had any luck? I know it's a pain to ask, but I really do need a whole gland!
98282-progress.title: Alchemical Hazards

98283-progress.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
98283-progress.text:
The Rotclaw came down from their homes in Loch Modan, now driven mad.

Such a waste of life's boon.
98283-progress.title: Carnage
